_readme: Every image slot on the site. To use a real asset: put the file in src/assets/..., set 'src' to its path, set 'width'/'height', write 'alt', and set 'placeholder' to false. While 'src' is empty the site shows a clearly labelled placeholder instead. See ASSETS.md for sizes.

rollabopLogo.note: Official wordmark, made from the transparent master in brand-source/rollabop-wordmark-master.png (2172x724). To update: replace the master, then export 480/960/1280px-wide WebP versions.

lippyLogo.note: Official Lippy Robotics Labs logo (SVG preferred). Until supplied, the name is set in text.

appIcon.alt: Rollabop app icon: a glowing Galaxy Ball on walnut and brass
appIcon.note: Used for link previews (social image). Made from brand-source/app-icon-source.png with the white corners made transparent.

favicon.note: Browser tab icon: the Galaxy Ball cut out as a circle from brand-source/galaxy-ball-icon-source.png (the full scene is too detailed at 16-32px). apple-touch-icon.png is the framed app icon at 180px for phone home screens.

heroArt.alt: A tall walnut Rollabop tray with brass trim, holding a settled pile of glowing glass balls and one Galaxy Ball.
heroArt.note: Optional official hero render. Until supplied, the hero uses the site's built-in tray illustration.

galaxyBall.alt: A clear glass Galaxy Ball holding a miniature spiral galaxy.
galaxyBall.note: Official Galaxy Ball artwork, square, transparent background, at least 1200px. Until supplied, an interim illustration is shown and labelled.

googlePlayBadge.note: Official Google Play badge from Google's badge generator. Only shown once release.playStoreUrl is set.

gameplay1.label: Gameplay screenshot
gameplay1.note: A full tray mid-level, showing the pile.

gameplay2.label: Gameplay screenshot
gameplay2.note: A match or cascade in progress.

levelSelect.label: Level select
levelSelect.note: The real level-select screen, once built.
